certifiedResults.title: Illinois official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are aggregated from the official Illinois State Board of Elections 2024 General Election PRESIDENT AND VICE PRESIDENT CSV. The parser rolls separate city election jurisdictions into their parent counties and excludes blank, under-vote, and over-vote rows from candidate totals.
